performance.scope: Earlier worker/storage/rendering and document reports retain their original source/binary identities. This source adds a separately identified optimized direct-API installed-plugin workload; no full-app latency, memory or speedup claim.

documents.scope: Direct native API, revision hash/native parse/JSON. Excludes helper IPC, host resource admission, UI, display/input and save-copy.

plugins.scope: CapabilityService::execute: shared cross-process resource admission, installed catalog/lease/package validation, cached Wasmtime component instantiation, fuel-bounded echo execution and JSON serialization; result decoding/assertions excluded
limitations: Direct native API excludes helper startup/IPC, host admission, agent approvals and UI input/rendering.
Single tiny component with no host imports, tools, network or models; not a representative plugin or task-quality benchmark.
Installation validates/compiles the component and may populate its cache. First run is one post-install observation, not a cold-launch percentile.
No memory-use, concurrency, OS acceptance or Rust-versus-Python speedup is measured.
Hardware/load are point-in-time observations; ordinary system activity is uncontrolled.

validation_limitations.first_integration_run: Two pre-existing local image HTTP fixtures exceeded their 5-second listener deadline while optimized linking was active; failure retained in docs/evidence/2026-10-25-document-integration-first-workspace-tests.log. The unchanged application code passed 294 tests after linking ended. This is not proof of the timeout cause or stressed live-provider acceptance.
validation_limitations.initial_lint: Strict all-target Clippy found an example-only manual-is-multiple-of assertion. Replaced it with the standard integer method, rebuilt/re-measured the harness and reran all gates. Initial lint evidence is retained.
validation_limitations.native_os: Physical on-screen/input/device/account and Windows/Linux acceptance remain unqualified.
validation_limitations.parallel_fixture_timing: Initial full parallel workspace run exposed a premature image-fixture listener deadline and one 20-second plugin fixture timeout. The listener deadline now excludes approval/admission queuing; provider response timeout remains five seconds. The plugin completed in subsequent isolated/full parallel engine checks without changing its 20-second deadline. Its initial cause remains unproven; the raw failed run and checkpoint diagnostics are retained.
validation_limitations.native_harness_compile: The new screenshot-only heading wrapper initially used a button API on a Div. Corrected to the pinned GPUI aria_label API before the final native compile/captures/Clippy; initial compiler log retained. No production UI source changed for this correction.
validation_limitations.lifecycle_review: Review corrected the real resumed-turn reconciliation order and a plugin filesystem TOCTOU before the final source freeze. Unix plugin reads use no-follow opened handles; Windows workspace-read import fails closed pending a qualified native implementation. Live OS/services, physical UI, accounts and devices remain unqualified.
